verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֣את בֵּֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַנִּקְרָאִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יָצָ֑אוּ וּמִמֵּ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַֽנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים׀ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה יַזְכִּ֔ירוּ וּבֵאלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֥א בֶאֱמֶ֖ת וְלֹ֥א בִצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- zōṯ bêṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ han·niq·rā·’îm bə·šêm yiś·rā·’êl yā·ṣā·’ū ū·mim·mê yə·hū·ḏāh han·niš·bā·‘îm bə·šêm Yah·weh yaz·kî·rū ū·ḇê·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lō ḇe·’ĕ·meṯ wə·lō ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Listen to this O house of Jacob you who are called by the name of Israel who have descended from the line of Judah who swear by the name of the LORD who invoke the God of Israel but not in truth [or] righteousness

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נִקְרָ֔אוּ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ מֵעִ֤יר נִסְמָ֑כוּ וְעַל־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- niq·rā·’ū haq·qō·ḏeš mê·‘îr nis·mā·ḵū wə·‘al- ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel the LORD of Hosts [is] His name

verses.original: הִגַּ֔דְתִּי הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת֙ מֵאָ֣ז יָצְא֖וּ וּמִפִּ֥י וְאַשְׁמִיעֵ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם עָשִׂ֖יתִי וַתָּבֹֽאנָה׃
verses.transliteration: hig·gaḏ·tî hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ mê·’āz yā·ṣə·’ū ū·mip·pî wə·’aš·mî·‘êm piṯ·’ōm ‘ā·śî·ṯî wat·tā·ḇō·nāh
verses.literal: I foretold the former things long ago they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them Suddenly I acted and they came to pass

verses.original: מִדַּעְתִּ֕י כִּ֥י אָ֑תָּה וְגִ֤יד קָשֶׁ֖ה עָרְפֶּ֔ךָ בַּרְזֶל֙ וּמִצְחֲךָ֖ נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: mid·da‘·tî kî ’āt·tāh wə·ḡîḏ qā·šeh ‘ā·rə·pe·ḵā bar·zel ū·miṣ·ḥă·ḵā nə·ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: For I knew that you . . . are stubborn your neck is iron and your forehead [is] bronze

verses.original: וָאַגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ מֵאָ֔ז הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא פֶּן־ תֹּאמַר֙ עָצְבִּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ם וּפִסְלִ֥י וְנִסְכִּ֖י צִוָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ag·gîḏ lə·ḵā mê·’āz hiš·ma‘·tî·ḵā bə·ṭe·rem tā·ḇō·w pen- tō·mar ‘ā·ṣə·bî ‘ā·śām ū·p̄is·lî wə·nis·kî ṣiw·wām
verses.literal: Therefore I declared it to you long ago I announced it before it came to pass so that you could not claim My idol has done this my carved image and molten god has ordained it

verses.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּֽ חֲזֵה֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם הֲל֣וֹא תַגִּ֑ידוּ מֵעַ֔תָּה הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֤יךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ וּנְצֻר֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tā ḥă·zêh kul·lāh wə·’at·tem hă·lō·w ṯag·gî·ḏū mê·‘at·tāh hiš·ma‘·tî·ḵā ḥă·ḏā·šō·wṯ ū·nə·ṣu·rō·wṯ wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tām
verses.literal: You have heard [these things] look at them all Will you not acknowledge [them]? From now on I will tell you of new things hidden things unknown to you . . .

verses.original: נִבְרְאוּ֙ עַתָּ֤ה וְלֹ֣א מֵאָ֔ז וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתָּ֑ם וְלִפְנֵי־ י֖וֹם פֶּן־ תֹּאמַ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה יְדַעְתִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·rə·’ū ‘at·tāh wə·lō mê·’āz wə·lō šə·ma‘·tām wə·lip̄·nê- yō·wm pen- tō·mar hin·nêh yə·ḏa‘·tîn
verses.literal: They are created now and not long ago you have not heard of them before today So you cannot claim I already knew them

verses.original: גַּ֣ם לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ גַּ֚ם לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ גַּ֕ם מֵאָ֖ז אָזְנֶ֑ךָ לֹא־ פִתְּחָ֣ה כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ בָּג֣וֹד תִּבְגּ֔וֹד קֹ֥רָא לָֽךְ׃ וּפֹשֵׁ֥עַ מִבֶּ֖טֶן
verses.transliteration: gam lō- šā·ma‘·tā gam lō yā·ḏa‘·tā gam mê·’āz ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā lō- p̄it·tə·ḥāh kî yā·ḏa‘·tî bā·ḡō·wḏ tiḇ·gō·wḏ qō·rā lāḵ ū·p̄ō·šê·a‘ mib·be·ṭen
verses.literal: - You have never heard . . . you have never understood . . . for a long time your ears have not been open For I knew how deceitful you are . . . you have been called a rebel from birth

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ אַאֲרִ֣יךְ אַפִּ֔י וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י אֶחֱטָם־ לָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַכְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an šə·mî ’a·’ă·rîḵ ’ap·pî ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî ’e·ḥĕ·ṭām- lāḵ lə·ḇil·tî haḵ·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath for the sake of My praise I will restrain it so that you will not be cut off

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה צְרַפְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א בְכָ֑סֶף בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ בְּכ֥וּר עֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ṣə·rap̄·tî·ḵā wə·lō ḇə·ḵā·sep̄ bə·ḥar·tî·ḵā bə·ḵūr ‘ō·nî
verses.literal: See I have refined you but not as silver I have tested you in the furnace of affliction

verses.original: לְמַעֲנִ֧י לְמַעֲנִ֛י אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣יךְ יֵחָ֑ל לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּֽן׃ס וּכְבוֹדִ֖י לְאַחֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘ă·nî lə·ma·‘ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kî ’êḵ yê·ḥāl lō- ’et·tên ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏî lə·’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: For My own sake My very own sake I will act for how can I let Myself be defamed I will not yield My glory to another

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־ הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲנִ֥י אַ֖ף אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ’ê·lay ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl mə·qō·rā·’î ’ă·nî- hū ’ă·nî ri·šō·wn ’ă·nî ’ap̄ ’a·ḥă·rō·wn
verses.literal: Listen to Me O Jacob and Israel whom I have called I am He I am the first and I am . . . the last

verses.original: אַף־ יָדִי֙ יָ֣סְדָה אֶ֔רֶץ וִֽימִינִ֖י טִפְּחָ֣ה שָׁמָ֑יִם אֲנִ֛י אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם קֹרֵ֥א יַעַמְד֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- yā·ḏî yā·sə·ḏāh ’e·reṣ wî·mî·nî ṭip·pə·ḥāh šā·mā·yim ’ă·nî ’ă·lê·hem qō·rê ya·‘am·ḏū yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Surely My own hand founded the earth and My right hand spread out the heavens when I . . . summon them they stand up together

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֤וּ כֻלְּכֶם֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔עוּ מִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם הִגִּ֣יד אֶת־ אֵ֑לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֲהֵב֔וֹ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה חֶפְצוֹ֙ בְּבָבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֖וֹ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ḵul·lə·ḵem ū·šă·mā·‘ū mî ḇā·hem hig·gîḏ ’eṯ- ’êl·leh Yah·weh ’ă·hê·ḇōw ya·‘ă·śeh ḥep̄·ṣōw bə·ḇā·ḇel ū·zə·rō·‘ōw kaś·dîm
verses.literal: Come together all of you and listen Which [of the idols] has foretold - these things The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon and His arm will be against the Chaldeans

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י אֲנִ֛י דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אַף־ קְרָאתִ֑יו הֲבִיאֹתִ֖יו וְהִצְלִ֥יחַ דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’ă·nî dib·bar·tî ’ap̄- qə·rā·ṯîw hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯîw wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ dar·kōw
verses.literal: I even I have spoken yes I have called him I have brought him and he will succeed in his mission

verses.original: קִרְב֧וּ אֵלַ֣י שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֗את מֵרֹאשׁ֙ לֹ֤א דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי בַּסֵּ֣תֶר מֵעֵ֥ת הֱיוֹתָ֖הּ אָ֑נִי שָׁ֣ם וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה שְׁלָחַ֖נִי וְרוּחֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: qir·ḇū ’ê·lay šim·‘ū- zōṯ mê·rōš lō dib·bar·tî bas·sê·ṯer mê·‘êṯ hĕ·yō·w·ṯāh ’ā·nî šām wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî wə·rū·ḥōw
verses.literal: Come near to Me and listen to this From the beginning I have not spoken in secret from the time it happened I was there And now the Lord GOD has sent me accompanied by His Spirit

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְךָ֖ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מְלַמֶּדְךָ֣ לְהוֹעִ֔יל מַדְרִֽיכֲךָ֖ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh gō·’al·ḵā qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mə·lam·meḏ·ḵā lə·hō·w·‘îl maḏ·rî·ḵă·ḵā bə·ḏe·reḵ tê·lêḵ
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer the Holy One of Israel I am the LORD your God who teaches you for your benefit who directs you in the way you should go

verses.original: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָ֑י שְׁלוֹמֶ֔ךָ וַיְהִ֤י כַנָּהָר֙ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֖ כְּגַלֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lū hiq·šaḇ·tā lə·miṣ·wō·ṯāy šə·lō·w·me·ḵā way·hî ḵan·nā·hār wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā kə·ḡal·lê hay·yām
verses.literal: If only you had paid attention to My commandments your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like waves of the sea

verses.original: זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וַיְהִ֤י כַחוֹל֙ וְצֶאֱצָאֵ֥י מֵעֶ֖יךָ כִּמְעֹתָ֑יו שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֧ת וְֽלֹא־ יִשָּׁמֵ֛ד מִלְּפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: zar·‘e·ḵā way·hî ḵa·ḥō·wl wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’ê mê·‘e·ḵā kim·‘ō·ṯāw šə·mōw lō- yik·kā·rêṯ wə·lō- yiš·šā·mêḏ mil·lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Your descendants would have been as [countless as] the sand and your offspring . . . as [numerous as] its grains their name would never be cut off . . . or eliminated from My presence

verses.original: צְא֣וּ מִבָּבֶל֮ בִּרְח֣וּ מִכַּשְׂדִּים֒ הַגִּ֤ידוּ בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּ֗ה הַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ זֹ֔את הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ עַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ אִמְר֕וּ יְהוָ֖ה גָּאַ֥ל עַבְדּ֥וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·’ū mib·bā·ḇel bir·ḥū mik·kaś·dîm hag·gî·ḏū bə·qō·wl rin·nāh haš·mî·‘ū zōṯ hō·w·ṣî·’ū·hā ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ ’im·rū Yah·weh gā·’al ‘aḇ·dōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Leave Babylon Flee from the Chaldeans Declare it with a shout of joy proclaim it let it go out to the ends of the earth saying The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א צָמְא֗וּ הֽוֹלִיכָ֔ם בָּחֳרָבוֹת֙ מַ֥יִם הִזִּ֣יל לָ֑מוֹ מִצּ֖וּר וַיִּ֨בְקַע־ צ֔וּר מָֽיִם׃ וַיָּזֻ֖בוּ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṣā·mə·’ū hō·w·lî·ḵām bā·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ ma·yim hiz·zîl lā·mōw miṣ·ṣūr way·yiḇ·qa‘- ṣūr mā·yim way·yā·zu·ḇū
verses.literal: They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts He made water flow for them from the rock He split the rock and water gushed out

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָרְשָׁעִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ên šā·lō·wm ’ā·mar Yah·weh lā·rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: There is no peace says the LORD for the wicked
